headline: Archipelago separates saves by room; Difficulty preserves Blarg Station spawns
summary: Archipelago now remembers the room associated with each save slot and refuses a save from another seed, alongside logic and connection fixes. Difficulty reserves space for Blarg Station's own objects so extra enemies do not displace the ship and Clank. Mod index changes also make publishing failures and invalid newest releases more visible.
highlights: Archipelago adopts SDK 1.11 and checks each memory card slot's room (#26).
Archipelago fixes include seed checks, reconnect handling and location IDs (#24).
Blarg Station gets no enemy copies when its object pool cannot accommodate them (#34).
Release jobs explicitly trigger index rebuilding, and listings record AI assistance per mod (#27, #33).
